prompt:
Write a WhatsApp group chat export in Hinglish (Roman script) for a fictional UPI-fraud training case.
Group members (use exactly these names as senders): Pooja R., Pranab bhai, Pooja didi, Raju bhai.
The chat covers 18/03/26, 6:45 pm to 18/03/26, 8:45 pm. It must have exactly 29 message lines, in time order.
Line format, one message per line, nothing else:
DD/MM/YY, h:mm am - Sender: message text
These messages must appear word for word, in this order, with these exact timestamps and senders:
18/03/26, 7:38 pm - Pooja didi: Pranab bhai, wo transfer ka record delete kar dena abhi
Fill the other lines with ordinary conversation. Do not add a header or explanations.
text:
18/03/26, 6:45 pm - Raju bhai: Haan bhai, aaj ka kya scene hai? Target poora hua?
18/03/26, 6:48 pm - Pranab bhai: Abhi tak toh bas 3 log hi aaye hain line pe.
18/03/26, 6:51 pm - Pooja R.: Mere wale ne bol diya ki UPI pin nahi batayega.
18/03/26, 6:55 pm - Raju bhai: Usse bolo OTP aur PIN balance check karne ke liye mandatory hai.
18/03/26, 6:58 pm - Pooja didi: Shanti se baat karo, tension mat do usko.
18/03/26, 7:02 pm - Pranab bhai: QR code bhej diya hai ek uncle ko, bole cash reward mila hai.
18/03/26, 7:06 pm - Pooja R.: Haha, wo maan gaye kya?
18/03/26, 7:10 pm - Pranab bhai: Haan, keh rahe hain link open kar diya hai.
18/03/26, 7:14 pm - Raju bhai: Sahi hai, bol receive ka option aayega, PIN daalo.
18/03/26, 7:18 pm - Pooja didi: Direct call pe bane raho, disconnect mat hone dena.
18/03/26, 7:22 pm - Pooja R.: Ek ma'am bank support ke naam se call back maang rahi hain.
18/03/26, 7:25 pm - Raju bhai: Wo fraud department wali lagti hai, ignore karo.
18/03/26, 7:29 pm - Pranab bhai: Chal gaya 25k ka request! Uncle ne PIN daal diya.
18/03/26, 7:32 pm - Raju bhai: Zabardast! Money credited batch account me.
18/03/26, 7:35 pm - Pooja R.: Abhi uncle ka call aayega shouting karte hue.
18/03/26, 7:38 pm - Pooja didi: Pranab bhai, wo transfer ka record delete kar dena abhi
18/03/26, 7:41 pm - Pranab bhai: Ji didi, history clear kar raha hu app se.
18/03/26, 7:45 pm - Raju bhai: Next number kiske paas hai list me?
18/03/26, 7:49 pm - Pooja R.: Mere paas hai 50 numbers ka fresh data sheet.
18/03/26, 7:53 pm - Pooja didi: Ek baar verification kar lena data ka.
18/03/26, 7:58 pm - Pranab bhai: SIM card swap ka kya status hai Raju bhai?
18/03/26, 8:03 pm - Raju bhai: Kal naye SIM mil jayenge, tension mat lo.
18/03/26, 8:08 pm - Pooja R.: Aaj sham ko training session bhi hai na hamara?
18/03/26, 8:14 pm - Pooja didi: Haan, 8:30 pm ko sir aayenge online review ke liye.
18/03/26, 8:20 pm - Pranab bhai: Mai apna daily report excel sheet me update kar raha hu.
18/03/26, 8:26 pm - Raju bhai: Good, sab log apna target total add kar do.
18/03/26, 8:32 pm - Pooja R.: Shaandar, aaj total 80k achieve ho gaya.
18/03/26, 8:39 pm - Pooja didi: Sab log login details clear kar ke log off kar do.
18/03/26, 8:45 pm - Pranab bhai: Okay didi, kal subah milte hain sharp 9 am.
